item.title: helps keep wasps out of your hair?
item.content:encoded: sounds like just what I need, I was felled in front if a defunct Catholic School into a seizure? demonic attack? All I could remember before was a wasp or the like attacking my ponytail and uh I fell out. Much to my embarrassment and detriment as it was witnessed by you know everybody and they're Granny too. Sheesh the damn cop who showed up quickly had a tattoo of Mjolnir on his right hand……the people they let be cops nowadays. Well if I survive til my next birthday I should have made it out of the Dreaded Abyss! I swear if I do Im gonna burn that Tree of Life and the whole damn Arboretum if its the last thing I do……which it in fact very well may be.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Still, Wikipedia keeps the conversation off the main page.

I mean, I understand why it's like this. I just find the bickering to be fairly same-y, and the consistent presence of it an unnecessary burden for anyone who wants to work with this format in the future.

The core of it is very good, and I don't mind a limited amount of the discussion, which I think shows the many different perspectives on these things well. It's that in pretty much all of these, it overwhelms the content and disrupts the flow.

item.content:encoded: I really want to like these. There's a lot in them that I do. But they keep turning into comment sections on some New Age website. I get that the footnotes are intended to be more annotations than anything else, but they do start to grate. And why does the tone of each turn into a nearly wholly conversational one near the end, even in the unitalicized text?
